questions.question: A delusion is best defined as:

options.B: A recurrent intrusive thought recognised as senseless
options.C: A fixed false belief that is not amenable to reason and out of keeping with the person's culture
options.D: A false sensory perception without a stimulus

questions.explanation: Hallucination is a perception without an external stimulus.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: A perception in the absence of an external stimulus is called a:
questions.explanation: An illusion is a misperception of a real stimulus.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Mistaking a rope for a snake in dim light is an example of:
questions.explanation: Illusions are misinterpretations of real external stimuli.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Flight of ideas is characteristically seen in:
questions.explanation: Rapid shifting of thoughts with understandable connections.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: ‘Knight's move’ thinking, in which ideas are connected by loose, illogical links, is characteristic of:
questions.explanation: A type of loosening of associations.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Lack of insight in psychotic disorders refers to:

options.D: Failure to recognise that one is ill

questions.explanation: Assessed as part of the mental state examination.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Affect is defined as:

options.C: The observable, moment-to-moment expression of emotion

questions.explanation: Mood is the sustained emotional state reported by the patient.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Echolalia is:

options.D: Meaningless repetition of another person's words

questions.explanation: Seen in catatonia and autism.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Which of the following is a first-rank symptom of schizophrenia (Schneider)?

options.C: Third-person auditory hallucinations (running commentary) and thought insertion

questions.explanation: Also thought broadcasting, delusional perception and passivity phenomena.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Negative symptoms of schizophrenia include:

options.A: Alogia, avolition, flat affect and social withdrawal

questions.explanation: Negative symptoms respond poorly to typical antipsychotics.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: According to ICD-10, symptoms of schizophrenia should be present for at least:
questions.explanation: DSM-5 requires 6 months of continuous disturbance.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Which antipsychotic is the drug of choice in treatment-resistant schizophrenia?
questions.explanation: Requires blood count monitoring because of agranulocytosis.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Acute dystonia induced by antipsychotics is treated with:
questions.explanation: Tardive dyskinesia appears after long-term use.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Neuroleptic malignant syndrome is characterised by:

options.C: Hyperthermia, muscle rigidity, autonomic instability and raised CK

questions.explanation: Treated by stopping the drug, cooling, and dantrolene or bromocriptine.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: A core symptom of depression is:

options.B: Persistent low mood and loss of interest or pleasure

questions.explanation: ICD-10: duration of at least 2 weeks.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Which is a biological (somatic) symptom of depression?

options.A: Early morning waking with diurnal mood variation (worse in the morning)

questions.explanation: Also weight loss and psychomotor retardation.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: The first-line antidepressants are the:
questions.explanation: Examples: fluoxetine, sertraline, escitalopram.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Serotonin syndrome is characterised by:

options.C: Agitation, hyperthermia, tremor, clonus and autonomic instability

questions.explanation: Occurs with combinations of serotonergic drugs.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Which feature is characteristic of mania?

options.D: Elated or irritable mood, decreased need for sleep, grandiosity and pressure of speech

questions.explanation: Duration at least 1 week in DSM-5.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Lithium therapy requires monitoring of:

options.C: Serum lithium levels, renal and thyroid function

questions.explanation: It has a narrow therapeutic index; toxicity causes tremor, ataxia and diarrhoea.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Electroconvulsive therapy is most effective in:

options.B: Severe depression with psychotic features or high suicide risk

questions.explanation: Given under general anaesthesia with a muscle relaxant.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: The strongest predictor of future suicide is:
questions.explanation: Other risk factors: depression, substance use, hopelessness.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: A panic attack typically peaks within about:
questions.explanation: Characterised by palpitations, sweating, trembling and fear of dying.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Abrupt withdrawal from long-term benzodiazepines can cause:
questions.explanation: Withdrawal should be gradual.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: The core features of post-traumatic stress disorder are:

options.D: Re-experiencing, avoidance and hyperarousal after a traumatic event

questions.explanation: Symptoms persist for at least 1 month.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Somatisation disorder is characterised by:

options.A: Fixed belief of a delusional nature
options.D: Multiple, recurrent physical complaints without adequate medical explanation

questions.explanation: Malingering is feigning symptoms for obvious external gain.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Conversion (dissociative motor) disorder presents with:

options.C: Neurological symptoms (e.g. paralysis, blindness) without organic basis, in the context of psychological stress

questions.explanation: ‘La belle indifference’ may be seen.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Delirium tremens is characterised by:

options.A: Confusion, tremor, hallucinations and autonomic hyperactivity 2–5 days after stopping alcohol

questions.explanation: Treated with benzodiazepines and thiamine.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Opioid withdrawal features include:

options.B: Yawning, rhinorrhoea, dilated pupils, diarrhoea and piloerection

questions.explanation: Intoxication gives pinpoint pupils.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Disulfiram is used in alcohol dependence because it:

options.A: Inhibits aldehyde dehydrogenase causing an unpleasant reaction to alcohol
options.B: Reduces craving by acting on GABA

questions.explanation: Naltrexone and acamprosate reduce craving.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: ADHD is characterised by:

options.B: Inattention, hyperactivity and impulsivity beginning before age 12

questions.explanation: Methylphenidate is a first-line drug.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: The core features of autism spectrum disorder are:

options.A: Impaired social communication and restricted, repetitive behaviours

questions.explanation: Onset in early childhood.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: An IQ of 50–69 corresponds to:
questions.explanation: Moderate 35–49; severe 20–34; profound below 20.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Nocturnal enuresis is not diagnosed before the age of:
questions.explanation: Management includes alarm and desmopressin.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Delirium is characterised by:

options.A: Acute onset, fluctuating course, impaired consciousness and attention

questions.explanation: Dementia is a chronic progressive decline.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: In Alzheimer's disease the earliest cognitive impairment is typically of:
questions.explanation: Followed by disorientation, agnosia and personality change.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Korsakoff's syndrome is characterised by:

options.C: Anterograde amnesia with confabulation due to thiamine deficiency

questions.explanation: Follows untreated Wernicke's encephalopathy.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: Which cluster includes borderline, antisocial and histrionic personality disorders?
questions.explanation: Cluster A (odd): paranoid, schizoid, schizotypal; Cluster C (anxious): avoidant, dependent, obsessive–compulsive.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)

questions.question: In anorexia nervosa, a body mass index below which value is characteristic?
questions.explanation: Amenorrhoea and distorted body image are features.
questions.sourceBook: Niraj Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry; ICD-10/DSM-5 criteria (chapter-level reference)
